question: After getting two successive discounts, Seema got a shirt at Rs. 153, for which the marked price was Rs. 200. If the second discount was 15%, the first discount was:
solution:
Given:

Cost price = 153 Rs.

MRP = 200 Rs.

Second Discount(D2) = 15%

First Discount(D%) = ?

Formula used: 

CP = MRP× {(100-D₁)over100}×{(100-D₂)over100} 

D% = D×100over MRP

Calculation:

Let the price after the first discount = X 

⇒ X × (100-15)over100 = 153

⇒ X × 85over100 = 153

⇒ X = 153×100over85

⇒ X = 180

⇒ 180 is the price after the first discount of Rs. 200 is the original discount.

Discount is given in the first instance = 200-180=20 

D% = 20×100over200 = 10%

**∴ The option 3 is correct.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** Let the first discount = D1%

⇒ 200× {(100-D₁)over100}×{(100-15)over100} = 153

⇒ 200× {(100-D₁)over100}×{85over100} = 153

⇒ 100-D₁ = 90

⇒ D1 = 10%

∴ The first Discount D1 = 10%.
